240-5256-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

539-1462-2921-3821-4679.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-2921-3821-4679.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat

301-7096-7861.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
301-7096-7861.description:
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6154.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6154.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1718-2523-2869.description:
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Catalyst Elemental token

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

222-527-5434-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5434-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

215-729-4026.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}
215-729-4026.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Elvish Piper by paying {G} and tapping it, putting Great Oak Guardian from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2445-5147-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

7-4907-6798-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4907-6798-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

997-2281-5237.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
997-2281-5237.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3140-3169-4659-7070.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Soltari Guerrillas.
Cast Soltari Guerrillas from exile by paying {2}.
When Soltari Guerrillas enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-3668--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Flesh Duplicate that has haste. Choose to have Flesh Duplicate enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Flesh Duplicate token instead.
618-3668--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Flesh Duplicate's toughness.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3713-3755-5078-5243.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

147-2562-5256.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

589-2498-2919.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-2498-2919.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

969-3259-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
969-3259-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1090-5686-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Restoration Angel.
1090-5686-6132.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2281-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiendish Panda enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

803-1238-2351-5231-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Repeat.

974-5090-5470.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Singing Bell Strike attached to Ghired.
974-5090-5470.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 3.
974-5090-5470.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Ghired to copy any other token(s) that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.

1437-4940.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-4940.description:
Cast Adaptive Sporesinger by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Adaptive Sporesinger spell three times.
Resolve the first Adaptive Sporesinger spell.
When the Adaptive Sporesinger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-4940.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Adaptive Sporesinger spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

3652-5852-5929.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Ornithopter triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Ornithopter spells, causing the nontoken Ornithopter to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

2724-3217-3582-5256.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Wormfang Manta's power.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

1294-2167-4423-4482-5122.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands and one basic Forest.
1294-2167-4423-4482-5122.description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Summer Bloom by paying {1}{G}, allowing you to play three more lands this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, putting Summer Bloom on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Cryptic Caves' second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Summer Bloom from the top of your library.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and a basic Forest, adding {G}{U}.
Play the Forest and Cryptic Caves from your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Mystic Barrier

736-3790.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
736-3790.description:
At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, Mystic Barrier and Copy Enchantment trigger, choosing "left" for Mystic Barrier and "right" for Copy Enchantment.
As long as there are three or more players in the game, creatures cannot attack.

565-2909-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
565-2909-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

1494-3337-4802.notablePrerequisites: Master Biomancer has a power of five or greater.Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
1494-3337-4802.description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sage of Hours that enters the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters due to Master Biomancer.
Activate the Sage of Hours token by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

77-2618-4069-4399.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Spirit Loop.
Spirit Loop and Starfield Mystic triggers.
Resolve the Starfield Mystic trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spirit Loop trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Spirit Loop by paying two life, targeting any creature.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2302-3144.description:
Painter's Servant causes all creatures to be red in addition to their other colors.
Wrath of Marit Lage prevents red creatures from untapping during their controller's untap steps.

1524-2724-3194.notablePrerequisites: Ilharg does not have summoning sickness.
1524-2724-3194.description:
Attack with Ilharg.
Ilharg's attack trigger triggers, putting Wormfang Manta onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Wormfang Manta is returned to your hand.
This triggers its LTB, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.
